reason: A browser plugin centered on interactive Mermaid diagram visualization and editing, with bidirectional code synchronization and documented agent-conversation integration.

summaries.zh: 在浏览器中提供支持流程图、时序图、类图和实体关系图的 Mermaid 可视化编辑器，并与当前会话双向传递图表代码。
summaries.en: A browser-based Mermaid visualization editor for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, and entity-relationship diagrams with bidirectional code exchange with the current conversation.

capabilities: Provides an in-page Mermaid diagram editor for four diagram types
Synchronizes visual canvas edits with Mermaid code
Stores per-session tabs, diagrams, code, and viewport state in localStorage
Registers the mermaid_load model tool and exchanges Mermaid code with the current conversation
Modifies the host page layout by adding a resizable editor panel
